chapter: Second session: boyhood, brothers and early road years
title: Sister Viola, her violin and Fisk University
summary: Viola played the piano and violin, toured with the Tuskegee Jubilee Singers and studied at Fisk.

story.theme_name: Growing up and learning music: family, first instruments, teachers
story.community_name: Where I came from: parents, siblings and birth

blocks.x: And your sister Viola, who was the pianist-- you told me she played with the Tuskegee Jubilee ...she travelled with
And she was also a accomplished violinist.
Oh! You didn't tell me that.
Yeah. She played violin just as equal as she did piano but piano was her main interest.
Where did she study violin? Was that in Texas...or after...?
Well, she started, I think, in Texas, yeah. And she was also a graduate from Tuskegee...not Tuskegee...uh, Nashville--what's that school there? Fisk University.
Oh, yes, of course. Ohhh. She studied music there?
She studied...went to school there for three or four years, you know.
